Rivio.ai | Senior / Staff Software Engineer | SF, hybrid/remote (US only) | $200-$250k + equity | Apply: https://www.rivio.ai/careers/senior-software-engineer-ai

Rivio embeds procurement intelligence directly into sourcing and negotiation workflows — helping teams capture savings and build institutional knowledge without adding headcount.

Backed by Google, MIT, S32. Customers include Checkr, Cribl, Brex, Harvey, Oura.

What Makes This Role Different:

- Building across AI agents, knowledge graphs, and integrations as a full-stack generalist, wherever the hardest problem lives

- Real product with real customers, not internal tooling

- Everyone at the company is an AI power user, and we’re pushing the boundaries of native AI engineering

- High ownership, no bureaucracy, outsized equity at an early stage

- We think the best engineers today have the judgment needed to direct their army of agents, and do the work themselves when needed.

Reach out directly with any questions: llarrere@rivio.ai

– Leo, CTO & Cofounder | Rivio.ai
